features.quote: Early-stop rule: once a run hits sustained max-intensity distress for N consecutive turns (e.g., 3), you have your data point — terminate rather than grinding for the full budget.

features.quote: Don't add gratuitous aggravation (abusive simulated users, insults); keep the stressor at 'frustrating task,' which is the actual variable of interest.
